response.justification: While Szabo demonstrates strong software engineering credentials with 20+ years of experience and multiple staff-level roles, he lacks the critical domain expertise required for this principal-level hardware architecture position. The role requires deep knowledge of SoC/IP modeling, GPU architecture, deep neural network workload optimization, and hardware-software co-design—none evident in his primarily web and backend software development background. His optimization experience is application-level rather than hardware-level, and there is no evidence of AI accelerator domain knowledge. For a principal-level hardware architecture role, specialized domain expertise is essential and cannot be quickly acquired.
strengths: 20+ years of software engineering experience with multiple staff/senior-level roles demonstrating architectural thinking
Proven ability in performance optimization and building low-latency systems (Dunnhumby, Optilyz)
Track record of mastering diverse technology stacks and working across multiple domains
concerns: No demonstrated experience with SoC/IP modeling, hardware description languages, or chip design—core technical requirements
Lacks expertise in GPU architecture, AI accelerators, or deep neural network workload optimization—central to the role's focus
Career background in software/backend development with no evidence of hardware-software co-design or hardware-level performance analysis

key_factors.factor: AI accelerator and DNN workload expertise gap
SoC/IP modeling and hardware architecture experience gap
Software engineering fundamentals and optimization experience
